Meet your guide

I built ZIM because nothing else worked for my ADHD brain.

I'm Tati — multilingual wellness creator, consciousness explorer, and the mind behind Zen in Motion. I've had ADHD my whole life without knowing it. I tried every meditation technique that existed and failed at all of them. The more I failed, the worse I felt about my own mind.

One day while running, I visualized violet flame energy at a painful knee — and the pain disappeared instantly. I realized: movement makes visualization exponentially more powerful. From that moment, ZIM was born.

Today I've guided hundreds of people into elevated states of clarity, joy, and peace — many for the first time in their lives.

Questions

Everything you need to know

Do I need dance or meditation experience?
+
Not at all. ZIM requires zero prior experience. If you can move your body — even gently — you can do ZIM. The method meets you exactly where you are.
I've never been able to meditate. Will this really work for me?
+
That's exactly who ZIM was designed for. Traditional meditation asks your hyperactive mind to do something it's wired against. ZIM works with your energy, not against it — which is why people who have "failed" at meditation for years experience results with ZIM in their first session.
How much time does a ZIM practice take?
+
Most ZIM practices are 5 to 10 minutes. You can do them at home, in your office, or outdoors. No special equipment or clothing needed.
What's the difference between ZIM and yoga or dance therapy?
+
ZIM is unique: it combines intentional movement with specific energetic visualizations — like violet flame, golden light, frequency clearing — guided by high-vibration music. It's not fitness. It's not therapy. It's a consciousness elevation practice through the body.
Is ZIM spiritual? Do I need to believe in something?
+
ZIM uses energetic concepts (frequency, visualization, consciousness) but requires no specific belief system. If you're open to the idea that your body holds energy and your mind shapes your reality — ZIM will work for you.
How does the 7-day Guarantee Period work?
+
The 7-day Guarantee Period applies to the ZIM Course ($197) only. If you are not satisfied, simply contact us within 7 days of purchase and you'll receive a complete refund — no questions asked, no hassle. This guarantee does not apply to ZIM Immersion or ZIM VIP coaching packages, as these involve personalized time and sessions reserved exclusively for you.
How do I access the course after purchase?
+
You'll receive your access information by email immediately after purchase. The content can be viewed or downloaded on any device — desktop, smartphone, tablet, or other digital device. You can also access it anytime by logging into Hotmart → My Account → My Purchases.
Does the ZIM Course include a completion certificate?
+
The ZIM Course is a personal transformation and wellness practice — it does not include a digital completion certificate. ZIM is designed for your own growth, energy elevation, and daily wellbeing, not as a professional training program.
